real_label_rule: Reuse all4000 real attempts. A usable CHGNet label requires converged=True, raw atomic and cell fmax in[0,0.1], finite formation energy, valid final structure and no error; accepted_physics is a separate synthetic eligibility flag and is not the real-label coverage criterion.

resume_retention_policy.step1: Keep historical accepted_POOL3304 in exact cache retention order; keep TEST1000 unchanged.
resume_retention_policy.step2: Retry only29 sorted CUDA-error candidate IDs from their full frozen initial structures. Append each strictly physical-accepted, nonduplicate success in sorted retry-ID order, without mutating old failed attempts.
resume_retention_policy.step3: Continue frozen POOL from zero-based index3600 (H2-P-003600), preserving prefix order and append passing nonduplicates until exactly5000 retained.
resume_retention_policy.dedup: Initialize retained composition identity/dedup with historical TEST1000+POOL3304 only; failed historical CUDA rows do not reserve membership. A successful retried candidate enters exactly once. All frozen synthetic compositions are globally unique, so repeated retry ID handling is the main membership duplicate risk.
resume_retention_policy.TEST_surplus: Historical8 TEST quota-surplus structures retain TEST identity and cannot enter POOL.
resume_retention_policy.ledger: Keep formal_attempts.jsonl immutable; append new retries/tail attempts to a separate resume ledger. Final dataset selects one successful record per retained ID.
